name: @absolutejs/compliance
description: Framework-agnostic compliance substrate for the AbsoluteJS PaaS. Declarative data classification + residency + retention policies; orchestrators for retention sweeps, Subject Access Requests, right-to-erasure, and evidence bundles. Composes onto @absolutejs/audit + @absolutejs/telemetry without vendoring any specific framework (SOC2 / HIPAA / ISO 27001 / GDPR).
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
